mechanism: Both drugs are components of hormone replacement therapy (HRT) or contraceptives used synergistically; medroxyprogesterone may enhance estradiol levels through hepatic metabolism inhibition and increase thrombotic/cardiovascular risk when combined.
action: Monitor for signs of thromboembolic events, breakthrough bleeding, and cardiovascular complications; use lowest effective doses and reassess risk-benefit regularly, particularly in patients >60 years or with cardiovascular risk factors.
